rank_math_title: 5 Day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund Tour with Omaruru
rank_math_desc: 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour from Windhoek: 2 nights in the Namib dunes, a Walvis Bay cruise and Omaruru game drive. From USD 2,150 per adult.
post_content: This 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour spends two nights in the Namib Desert for Deadvlei and Big Daddy Dune, then visits Swakopmund, Walvis Bay and Omaruru Game Lodge.
overview:
This 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour is a guided trip from Windhoek with 2 nights at Namib Naukluft Lodge, 1 night in Swakopmund and 1 night at Omaruru Game Lodge. It covers Big Daddy Dune, Deadvlei, Sesriem Canyon, Walvis Bay and a game drive. It runs all year, costs from USD 2,150 per adult and suits travellers who want desert, coast and wildlife.

The tour travels in a 4x4 Hilux with an English, Danish, Spanish or Italian-speaking driver guide, and all park entry fees and fixed accommodation are included.

Why choose a 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?

The 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour gives the Namib Desert two nights instead of one, so you can be in the dunes at sunrise without rushing. You climb Big Daddy, walk across Deadvlei and explore Sesriem Canyon before heading to the coast.

The last two days add what shorter desert trips miss: a harbour cruise at Walvis Bay with dolphins, pelicans and seals, and a night in the bushveld at Omaruru Game Lodge, where game drives can include elephants when time allows.

  • Active travellers: a climb of Big Daddy Dune and a walk in Sesriem Canyon.
  • Wildlife lovers: marine life at Walvis Bay and a game drive at Omaruru.
  • Photographers: two desert sunrises and the light on Dune 45.

What to expect on the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour

Day 1 starts with a meeting with your Divulge Adventures guide in Windhoek and a drive over the Spreetshoogte Pass, with apple pie in Solitaire, to Namib Naukluft Lodge. Day 2 is a pre-dawn trip into the Namib Desert for Big Daddy Dune, Deadvlei, Dune 45 and Sesriem Canyon, returning to the same lodge.

On day 3 you drive north through Solitaire and the Gaub and Kuiseb passes to the Atlantic, stopping at the Walvis Bay flamingo lagoon before the night in Swakopmund. Day 4 starts with the Walvis Bay Harbour Cruise, then continues inland to Omaruru Game Lodge for an afternoon game drive if time permits.

Day 5 may begin with a morning elephant drive at Omaruru, followed by the drive back to Windhoek and a city tour to end the trip.

Is 5 days enough for Sossusvlei and Swakopmund?

Five days is a comfortable length for Sossusvlei and Swakopmund, because the two nights at the desert lodge give you a full day in the dunes. It does not include Etosha, so ask us to add Etosha if big game is your priority. For a shorter version, see our 4 day Sossusvlei and Walvis Bay safari. Our best time to visit Namibia guide covers the seasons.

What is included in this Namibia desert and coast tour?

The price includes a multilingual driver guide, pick-up and drop-off at your accommodation, transport in a 4x4 Hilux, fixed accommodation as per the itinerary, the meals stated in the tour description, the listed activities, all park entry fees, passenger liability insurance, and still and sparkling water.

Not included are flights, travel and health insurance, visa fees, meals not listed, snacks and drinks, and optional activities. Read our guide to guided Namibia safaris and our ultimate Namibia safari guide to plan the rest of your trip.

How much does the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour cost?

From USD 2,150 per adult. The final price depends on your travel dates, group size and lodge availability, and we confirm every detail in your written quote.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour runs all year, and the trip page does not set a season. May to September is cooler for the Big Daddy climb and Deadvlei, while December to February is hot inland. Swakopmund and Walvis Bay stay mild with morning fog, so bring a warm layer for the harbour cruise.

faq.q: What is included in the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour includes a multilingual driver guide, a 4x4 Hilux, pick-up and drop-off at your accommodation, fixed accommodation, the stated meals, the listed activities, all park entry fees, passenger liability insurance and water. Flights, insurance, visas, unlisted meals, snacks, drinks and optional activities are extra.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: On this Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour you stay 2 nights at Namib Naukluft Lodge, 1 night in Swakopmund and 1 night at Omaruru Game Lodge. The page does not name the Swakopmund property, so we confirm it, with every other lodge, in your written quote.

faq.q: Is the 5 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes, families can join the Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour. The Big Daddy climb is steep but optional, and children usually enjoy the seals and dolphins on the Walvis Bay cruise and the game drive at Omaruru. Tell us your children's ages and we will plan the pace and stops to suit them.

faq.a: To book the Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour, send the enquiry form on this page, WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888 or email bookings@divulgeadventures.com with your dates and group size. We reply with a written quote, confirm the lodges and arrange your pick-up in Windhoek.
